title: Add Rythm — non-custodial email paywall using Cashu
body:
Adds Rythm to the Various nutcases section.

Rythm is a non-custodial email paywall for Gmail and Outlook. Unknown senders attach a Cashu token as a cover charge, which is melted on receipt and settled to the recipient's Lightning wallet. Built with cashu-ts, supports V3 and V4 tokens.

https://rythm.xyz

title: Add Cashu Bot — Telegram wallet + HTLC trustless gaming (NUT-14)
body:
## Cashu Bot

Telegram bot and Mini App for Cashu e-cash with:

- **Multi-mint wallet** — deposit/withdraw Lightning, P2P gifts (HMAC-SHA256)
- **P2PK escrow gaming (Level 2)** — custodial coin flip with configurable fee split
- **HTLC trustless gaming (Level 3, NUT-14)** — non-custodial coin flip with commit-reveal protocol and verifiable fraud proofs
- **Pay-per-minute streaming** — real-time sats streaming with auto-stop
- **Nostr bridge** — NIP-47 (Wallet Connect) + NIP-57 (Zaps)
- **Telegram Mini App** — React/Vite webapp for HTLC game flow
- **700 tests** (683 unit + 17 integration against real mint)

Stack: Python (aiogram, SQLAlchemy, aiohttp), React/Vite, native Cashu protocol (NUT-10/11/14, BDHKE, Schnorr BIP-340).

Repo: https://github.com/ttendoscopie-creator/cashu_bot-
